
{{Hatnote|Not to be confused with [[Alo (initiation order)]], or [[Alo (mantra)]]
}}
[[File:Alo Nine.svg|thumb]]
Alo is the divinity of [[Lifeism]]. It is composed ot three different aspects

* [[Alpha]]
* [[Lambda]]
* [[Omega]]

== Names in Other languages, and number of Syllables ==
[[File:Alo relationships.svg|thumb]]
Alo is sometimes called [[𠫜]] in Japanese and pronounces as Aro (あろ) or Aruo (あるお)

Alo is written as [[阿𠫜]] (Aluo, two syllables) in Chinese or sometimes with three characters for three syllables. 

The three vs two syllables dillemma comes from the name of the deity vs the mantra. The mantra has three syllables in English (AAAAA-LLLLL-OOOOO)  but not all languages have approximants that can treat Lambda as a separate syllable

In the Rotokas language Alo is pronounced as Aro (ado) or Aruo (aduo) due to lack of approximants.
